message:
Prepare the update. Reply with {"messages": [...], "revised_schedule": [...], "volunteer_tasks": [...]} as in the ripple-contracts skill. Do NOT create files: Ripple builds the .ics and .csv itself.
- One message per affected group (effect "inform", "resize" or the disruption origin); "group" = the group id. Say only what changed for that group. status "draft".
- "to": the address of a single person (see the attached people.csv), otherwise a short description like "40 workshop participants".
- "actions": the recovery checklist for the organizer team, 3 to 8 items, most urgent first: {"title", "description", "owner" (a role or team named in the files, e.g. "Volunteer lead", "Organizer", "Caterer"), "deadline" (a time or day taken from the plan, never invented), "priority" ("high"|"medium"|"low")}. Include confirming every item of the chosen option's "to_confirm" list.
- "revised_schedule": every schedule item or commitment whose time or place changes: {"id": node id, "start": "HH:MM", "end": "HH:MM", "place": "..."}. Empty list if nothing moves.

Key facts I'm working from:
- Speaker 2 is the affected group (people.csv, 1 person, email speaker2@example.com).
- Workshop participants (40) come from participants.csv, which was not uploaded and is not in the sandbox. I have only the group size from the disruption payload, so I'll use the description "40 workshop participants" as instructed.
- Chosen scenario B: the workshop slot is swapped with another 10:00 session, which is not yet identified. The to_confirm list has 5 items, which I'll all include as actions.
- The "grp_workshop_participants" group effect is "inform", so it gets a message.
- The only grounded `revised_schedule` change is workshop_s2 moving to 10:00-11:00 at a place to be confirmed. The new place is unknown, so I'll state "room B (to be confirmed)" and not invent a venue.
- Volunteer tasks: the volunteer lead is Greta Orchard (people.csv). Meet-up is 07:45, but no volunteer task is specified in the plan, so I'll only include the confirmation tasks owned by the volunteer lead as needed.

messages.subject: Your workshop time has changed
messages.body:
Hello Speaker 2,

Because your train is running about 2 hours late, we are moving your workshop. It will still run 10:00-11:00 in room B at Maison de l'Océan, but we are swapping it with another session that can start at 10:00. We are confirming the details now and will send you the final room and any changes to your slot as soon as they are confirmed.

Thank you for your flexibility.

messages.subject: Change to the 10:00 workshop
messages.body:
Hello,

The workshop by Speaker 2 scheduled for 10:00-11:00 in room B at Maison de l'Océan is affected by a late train. We are proposing to swap it with another session that can start at 10:00. We will confirm the session and room as soon as possible and let you know if anything else in your schedule changes.

Thank you for your understanding.
